name: gumgumfight
description: Simulador de One Piece Card Game no navegador (projeto de fã)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @gumgum/server" "wait-on -t 60000 http-get://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health && npm run dev -w @gumgum/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
